title: Open Spotlight
description: Search apps, files and settings, or do quick math and conversions.

title: Screenshot a selected area
description: Drag to capture part of the screen. Press Space while dragging to capture a whole window instead.

title: Screenshot and recording toolbar
description: Opens the capture toolbar with options for screen recording, timers and save location.

title: Force Quit Applications
description: Opens the Force Quit window to close an app that stopped responding.

title: Show hidden files in Finder
description: Toggles files that start with a dot, like .gitignore, in Finder and Open dialogs.

title: Shortcuts User Guide
description: Apple's guide to building your own automations in the Shortcuts app on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

title: Run a shortcut with Back Tap
description: Settings > Accessibility > Touch > Back Tap. Pick Double or Triple Tap and choose any shortcut to run it by tapping the back of the phone.

title: Snap layouts
description: Shows the snap layout picker for the active window on Windows 11.

title: Clipboard history
description: Paste from a list of recently copied items. Turn it on the first time you open it.

title: Snipping Tool
description: Capture a region, window or the full screen and copy it to the clipboard.

title: Open Task Manager
description: Opens Task Manager directly, without going through the Ctrl+Alt+Del screen.

title: Emoji and symbol panel
description: Insert emoji, kaomoji and special symbols into any text field.

title: Open a terminal (GNOME / Ubuntu)
description: Opens a new terminal window on Ubuntu and most GNOME desktops.

title: Command Palette
description: Run any command by name. Use Cmd+Shift+P on macOS.

title: Quick Open file
description: Jump to any file in the workspace by typing part of its name. Use Cmd+P on macOS.

title: Select next occurrence
description: Adds the next match of the current selection as another cursor. Use Cmd+D on macOS.

title: Keyboard Shortcuts editor
description: Opens the list of every binding so you can search and change them. Press Ctrl+K, release, then Ctrl+S.

title: Toggle integrated terminal
description: Shows or hides the terminal panel.

title: Save and quit
description: Writes the file and exits. In Normal mode, ZZ does the same.

title: Go to first line
description: Moves the cursor to the first line of the file. G goes to the last line.

title: Change inner word
description: Deletes the word under the cursor and enters Insert mode. Try ci" or ci( for quotes and brackets.

title: Repeat last change
description: Repeats the last edit at the cursor position. Pairs well with n to jump to the next search match.

title: Operator search menu
description: Search for any tool or operator by name (Blender 2.8 and later).

title: Grab (move)
description: Moves the selection. Follow with X, Y or Z to lock to an axis, or type a number for an exact distance. R rotates and S scales the same way.

title: View pie menu
description: Hold the backtick key for a pie menu of front, side, top and camera views.

title: Toggle Edit Mode
description: Switches the active object between Object Mode and Edit Mode.

title: Reopen closed tab
description: Brings back the last closed tab in Chrome, Firefox and Edge. Use Cmd+Shift+T on macOS.
